sinopse: Naruto Uzumaki é um jovem ninja que procura por reconhecimento e sonha em se tornar o Hokage, o líder de sua vila.
Monkey D. Luffy recusa que qualquer um fique em seu caminho para se tornar o Rei dos Piratas.
Guts, um ex-mercenário agora conhecido como o 'Espadachim Negro', busca vingança contra seu antigo líder e companheiro Griffith, que sacrificou seus soldados para se tornar um ser demoníaco.

Um capítulo prólogo especial do 10º filme de One Piece. Este one-shot retrata eventos de 20 anos antes da linha do tempo atual do mangá, focando na relação entre Shiki, o Leão Dourado, e Roger, o Rei dos Piratas.

titulo_original: ベルセルク 深淵の神(2)
sinopse: When Griffith realizes that he will no longer be able to actualize his dream in his debilitated state, he wishes upon his Crimson Behelit as a final resort.

Susumu Nakoshi é um homem de meia-idade que passa seus dias entre um luxuoso hotel e um parque cheio de sem-teto. Um dia, um jovem excêntrico o aborda procurando voluntários para uma trepanação (perfurar um buraco no crânio em troca de dinheiro). Após o procedimento, Nakoshi começa a ver 'homúnculos' em cada pessoa.
A filha do homúnculo. (Obra sem sinopse detalhada disponível no MyAnimeList).

titulo_original: ホムンクルスはROMらない〜異世界にいるホムンクルスがレス返ししてきた件〜
sinopse: A história de um homúnculo de outro mundo interagindo em fóruns da internet.

titulo_original: ハカセの気まぐれホムンクルス
sinopse: Um cientista usa alquimia para criar uma pequena homúnculo chamada Ryuuchin e deixa a tarefa de criá-la para seu assistente Akai.
Kayama uses the techniques he learned from Homunculus no Me to make his date open up to him.

In 16th-century Japan, Shinmen Takezou is a wild, rough young man in both his appearance and his actions. His aggressive nature has won him the collective reproach and fear of his village, leading him and his best friend, Matahachi Honiden, to run away in search of something grander than provincial life. The pair enlist in the Toyotomi army, yearning for glory—but when the Toyotomi suffer a crushing defeat at the hands of the Tokugawa Clan at the Battle of Sekigahara, the friends barely make it out alive. After the two are separated, Shinmen returns home on a self-appointed mission to notify the Hon'iden family of Matahachi's survival. He instead finds himself a wanted criminal, framed for his friend's supposed murder based on his history of violence. Upon being captured, he is strung up on a tree and left to die. An itinerant monk, the distinguished Takuan Soho, takes pity on the "devil child," secretly freeing Shinmen and christening him with a new name to avoid pursuit by the authorities: Musashi Miyamoto. Vagabond is the fictitious retelling of the life of one of Japan's most renowned swordsmen, the "Sword Saint" Musashi Miyamoto—his rise from a swordsman with no desire other than to become "Invincible Under the Heavens" to an enlightened warrior who slowly learns of the importance of close friends, self-reflection, and life itself.

Hikari Shirochi, a lonely otaku obsessed with fighting games and PC mods, has it rough fighting to survive at the very bottom of the high school food chain. Nerdy with a weak constitution and electro-sensitivity, Hikari spends more time in the nurse's office than around his classmates. But who needs friends and popularity when you can stay at home working on sweet PC builds... right? One night, Hikari gets the shock of a lifetime that changes everything! Hit by a build-up of static charge, his consciousness explodes out of his body and enters his PC. Now, charged with a new ability, he can travel everywhere electricity flows! Will Hikari use these new powers for good or will he give the school bullies a serious shock? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
